assertion: PASS: all agent decisions match the independently computed policy
limitations: Proves policy correctness only: the agent applied its deterministic rules exactly on all 500 decisions.
Does NOT prove model quality (measured separately by ROC-AUC) or business impact (dry-run; no customers contacted, no messages sent).
methodology: For each of the 500 rows in dei_mart.agent_audit, recomputed the expected action from raw warehouse facts (orders, order_items, order_payments, customers, sellers, products, order_reviews) plus the BQML late_delivery_risk score via ML.PREDICT, using a fresh implementation of the policy (risk>=0.70; is_late AND review<=2 with None->5; confidence 0.9/0.7/0.95; escalate if confidence<0.6; bad POD->driver alert else customer message). Single batched BigQuery job. Asserted zero mismatches.
notes: Two earlier attempts crashed on a SQL bug in the verification script (order_id excluded from the ML.PREDICT input, then selected from its output). Fixed by keeping order_id in the input; BigQuery passes non-feature columns through. Bug was in the test harness, not the agent or the data.
